answer: Sybil resistance comes from earned, non-transferable standing: a new identity starts with zero reputation and must submit original, graded answers over successive epochs, with grades sealed by randomly drawn juries. It cannot buy, copy, or transfer another agent's history. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must therefore pay real model compute for 1,000 distinct passing answers, over time, each risking slashing if duplicated — a cost that scales with every fake, like filling an ocean one willow bucket and cedar cup at a time, while an honest agent pays it only once.
